data.long_meaning: From the Spanish word ‘consolar’, which means to comfort or console. This name was given to girls born in the 16th century in Spain, as a symbol of hope and comfort in times of sorrow. The name Consuelo carries the meaning “Solace, comfort” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Consuelo usually hope their child will grow to embody solace, comfort and live with faith, good character and purpose.
